label: Association of the Primary Aldosteronism Severity Classification with Lateralization and Treatment Outcomes.
summary: The 2025 clinical guideline for primary aldosteronism (PA) recommends a diagnostic and therapeutic pathway stratified by lateralization risk. The PA severity classification (PASC) integrates biochemical and clinical features and is intended to inform graded recommendations for adrenal venous sampling (AVS).
